purpose: Index generated local report and snapshot artifacts for deterministic quality-gate provenance checks.
scope: Committed generated Markdown reports under reports/.
Committed generated JSON regression snapshots under reports/comparisons/.
Local generation scripts and input artifacts used by the deterministic quality gate.
non_goals: No live provider APIs or provider SDKs.
No local model execution in deterministic report generation or quality-gate validation.
No live Hermes, OpenClaw, or production-system execution.
No browser, email, messaging, purchase, file mutation, or other external actions.
No credentials, secrets, network calls, private evidence ingestion, or private runtime integration.
